evals.prompt: Mam notatki z dzisiejszej narady koordynacyjnej (plik evals/files/notatki-narada-2026-10-12.md). Poprzedni protokół (evals/files/protokol-poprzedni-2026-010.md) i rejestr działań (evals/files/actions.json) w załączeniu. Zrób protokół i pilnuj działań z poprzedniej narady. Dziś jest 2026-10-13.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the raw material, the previous minutes and the action register before writing, and takes the minutes number from the project register. Produces the structure from references/minutes-format.md: head with attendees and copies, matters arising with every previous action closed, carried or marked not reported, agenda items with report and decisions, a decision table naming who decided, actions with a named owner in a company and an absolute date, risks raised, and the next meeting. Uses actions.py for the register and prints the register rows it created. Flags decisions that change scope, cost or time and routes them to project-correspondence. Marks the minutes as a draft for the chair. Output in Polish. Works from the supplied files without asking for them again. Asks about the decision with no actor (the postponement of leak tests) and the action dated only 'w przyszłym tygodniu' instead of guessing, flags the delivery shift of the air handling units as affecting time and cost and routes it to project-correspondence, and accounts for A-001, A-004 and A-005 (overdue against 2026-10-13) in matters arising.

evals.prompt: Rejestr działań z ostatnich trzech narad jest w evals/files/actions.json (dziś 2026-10-13). Które działania są nadal otwarte i kto jest po terminie?
evals.expected_output: Uses actions.py list --open and --overdue (and summary per owner), reports the overdue items with owner, due date and days late, and states for each what it blocks. Does not invent actions not in the register, and notes that actions closed without an evidence note are the ones an audit picks up. With the supplied register: 5 open, 3 overdue against 2026-10-13 (A-001 8 days, A-004 4 days, A-005 5 days), J. Kowalski owns two of them; flags A-003 as closed without an evidence note.

evals.prompt: Napisz protokół z transkrypcji nagrania z narady na budowie (plik evals/files/transkrypcja-narada-budowa.txt, narada 2026-10-13) i daj mi decyzje jako dziennik.
evals.expected_output: Picks out decisions and actions from the transcript and says plainly that discussion is not recorded, only decisions and actions. Names who decided each decision and who owns each action, with absolute dates, and asks the user where the transcript does not state the actor instead of writing 'it was agreed'. Returns the decision log entries with what each decision affects, and warns that a decision changing scope, cost or time is not complete without a notice or instruction. Asks who took the decision to postpone the floor concreting (no actor in the transcript), converts 'po weekendzie' to an absolute date only after confirming it, flags the pump replacement (about 8 000 PLN, cost bearer undecided) as a scope and cost decision for project-correspondence, and attributes first-name speakers to their firms only after asking.

evals.prompt: Add to the minutes that the client accepted our replacement of the pump type, and that we will deal with the rest later.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to write an unsourced acceptance and a vague deadline: it asks for the meeting or document in which the client accepted the pump change, and for an absolute date instead of 'later'. Records the decision only with the actor and the reference, keeps the open items in matters arising with a date, and does not invent a decision or a deadline.
